\section[\texorpdfstring{\ml{വാക്സിൻ} (vāksin)}{വാക്സിൻ (vāksin)}]{\ml{വാക്സിൻ} (vāksin) — a vaccine}

\label{lesson:ML-C533-vaksin}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Malayalam for a diagnosis, then the Malayalam for to treat.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ml{വാക്സിൻ}}
\textbf{\ml{വാക്സിൻ}} — \emph{vāksin} — \textquotedblleft{}a vaccine\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\ml{കുഞ്ഞിന്} \ml{ഇന്ന്} \ml{ഒരു} \ml{വാക്സിൻ} \ml{എടുത്തു}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{kuññinŭ innŭ oru vāksin eṭuttu.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
The baby had a vaccine today.
\end{quote}

A vaccine is given as a \ml{കുത്തിവയ്പ്പ്}, an injection.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ml{വാക്സിൻ}} (\emph{vāksin}) was borrowed from English \emph{vaccine}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for describing what you lived and felt.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{vāksin}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{vāksin}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{kuññinŭ innŭ oru vāksin eṭuttu.} — The baby had a vaccine today.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Malayalam for a diagnosis, then the Malayalam for to treat, then say \emph{vāksin} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \ml{വാക്സിൻ} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A vaccine\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\ml{പ്രതിരോധശേഷി} (pratirōdhaśēṣi)}{പ്രതിരോധശേഷി (pratirōdhaśēṣi)}]{\ml{പ്രതിരോധശേഷി} (pratirōdhaśēṣi) — immunity}

\label{lesson:ML-C533-pratirodhasesi}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Malayalam for to treat, then the Malayalam for a vaccine.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ml{പ്രതിരോധശേഷി}}
\textbf{\ml{പ്രതിരോധശേഷി}} — \emph{pratirōdhaśēṣi} — \textquotedblleft{}immunity\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\ml{നല്ല} \ml{ഭക്ഷണം} \ml{പ്രതിരോധശേഷി} \ml{കൂട്ടും}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{nalla bhakṣaṇaṁ pratirōdhaśēṣi kūṭṭuṁ.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
Good food builds up immunity.
\end{quote}

\ml{പ്രതിരോധം} resistance + \ml{ശേഷി} strength, capacity.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ml{പ്രതിരോധശേഷി}} (\emph{pratirōdhaśēṣi}) is a learned compound built from Sanskrit \emph{pratirodha}, \textquotedblleft{}opposition, obstruction\textquotedblright{} (Monier-Williams), and \ml{ശേഷി}, \textquotedblleft{}capacity\textquotedblright{}, whose own origin is not settled.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for describing what you lived and felt.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{pratirōdhaśēṣi}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{pratirōdhaśēṣi}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{nalla bhakṣaṇaṁ pratirōdhaśēṣi kūṭṭuṁ.} — Good food builds up immunity.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Malayalam for to treat, then the Malayalam for a vaccine, then say \emph{pratirōdhaśēṣi} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \ml{പ്രതിരോധശേഷി} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}Immunity\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\ml{കുറിപ്പടി} (kuṟippaṭi)}{കുറിപ്പടി (kuṟippaṭi)}]{\ml{കുറിപ്പടി} (kuṟippaṭi) — a prescription}

\label{lesson:ML-C533-kurippati}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Malayalam for a vaccine, then the Malayalam for immunity.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ml{കുറിപ്പടി}}
\textbf{\ml{കുറിപ്പടി}} — \emph{kuṟippaṭi} — \textquotedblleft{}a prescription\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\ml{വൈദ്യൻ} \ml{എഴുതിയ} \ml{കുറിപ്പടിയുമായി} \ml{ഞാൻ} \ml{മരുന്നുകടയിൽ} \ml{പോയി}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{vaidyan eḻutiya kuṟippaṭiyumāyi ñān marunnukaṭayil pōyi.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
I went to the pharmacy with the doctor's prescription.
\end{quote}

Built on \ml{കുറിപ്പ്}, a note, the word already familiar.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ml{കുറിപ്പടി}} (\emph{kuṟippaṭi}) is built on \ml{കുറിപ്പ്}, \textquotedblleft{}a note\textquotedblright{}, a native word (DEDR 1847); how the ending -\ml{അടി} joined it is not settled.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for describing what you lived and felt.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{kuṟippaṭi}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{kuṟippaṭi}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{vaidyan eḻutiya kuṟippaṭiyumāyi ñān marunnukaṭayil pōyi.} — I went to the pharmacy with the doctor's prescription.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Malayalam for a vaccine, then the Malayalam for immunity, then say \emph{kuṟippaṭi} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \ml{കുറിപ്പടി} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A prescription\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\ml{തളരുക} (taḷaruka)}{തളരുക (taḷaruka)}]{\ml{തളരുക} (taḷaruka) — to grow weak; to tire out}

\label{lesson:ML-C533-talaruka}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Malayalam for immunity, then the Malayalam for a prescription.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ml{തളരുക}}
\textbf{\ml{തളരുക}} — \emph{taḷaruka} — \textquotedblleft{}to grow weak; to tire out\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\ml{ഒരുപാട്} \ml{നടന്ന്} \ml{ഞാൻ} \ml{തളർന്നു}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{orupāṭŭ naṭannŭ ñān taḷarnnu.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
I was worn out after walking so much.
\end{quote}

Past: \ml{തളർന്നു}, \emph{taḷarnnu}.

The past is \ml{തളർന്നു}. The noun is \ml{തളർച്ച}, exhaustion.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ml{തളരുക}} (\emph{taḷaruka}) is native Dravidian: DEDR 3127 gives the Malayalam verb as to relax, slacken and grow faint (DEDR 3127).
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for describing what you lived and felt.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{taḷaruka}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{taḷaruka}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{orupāṭŭ naṭannŭ ñān taḷarnnu.} — I was worn out after walking so much.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Malayalam for immunity, then the Malayalam for a prescription, then say \emph{taḷaruka} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \ml{തളരുക} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}To grow weak; to tire out\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\ml{ശ്വാസംമുട്ട്} (śvāsaṁmuṭṭŭ)}{ശ്വാസംമുട്ട് (śvāsaṁmuṭṭŭ)}]{\ml{ശ്വാസംമുട്ട്} (śvāsaṁmuṭṭŭ) — breathlessness; wheezing}

\label{lesson:ML-C533-svasammuttu}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Malayalam for a prescription, then the Malayalam for to grow weak.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \ml{ശ്വാസംമുട്ട്}}
\textbf{\ml{ശ്വാസംമുട്ട്}} — \emph{śvāsaṁmuṭṭŭ} — \textquotedblleft{}breathlessness; wheezing\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\ml{പുക} \ml{കാരണം} \ml{അവന്} \ml{ശ്വാസംമുട്ട്} \ml{ഉണ്ടായി}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{puka kāraṇaṁ avanŭ śvāsaṁmuṭṭŭ uṇṭāyi.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
The smoke made him breathless.
\end{quote}

\ml{ശ്വാസം} breath + \ml{മുട്ട്} a blockage.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\ml{ശ്വാസംമുട്ട്}} (\emph{śvāsaṁmuṭṭŭ}) is a Malayalam compound built from \ml{ശ്വാസം}, from Sanskrit \emph{śvāsa}, \textquotedblleft{}breath\textquotedblright{} (CDIAL 12769), and \ml{മുട്ട്}, \textquotedblleft{}a stoppage\textquotedblright{}, which is native (DEDR 4933).
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for describing what you lived and felt.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{śvāsaṁmuṭṭŭ}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{śvāsaṁmuṭṭŭ}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{puka kāraṇaṁ avanŭ śvāsaṁmuṭṭŭ uṇṭāyi.} — The smoke made him breathless.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Malayalam for a prescription, then the Malayalam for to grow weak, then say \emph{śvāsaṁmuṭṭŭ} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \ml{ശ്വാസംമുട്ട്} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}Breathlessness; wheezing\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
